title: Rung 3: musl hello-world reversible console, reset and tape replay gate
description: Implement the full North Star §8 rung 3 gate for ordinary musl hello.c on LLVM 18/23, dialect 0.2.10 @023f5a7 and ISA 0.8. Native comparison must use materialised runtimes/arith code (never host libc). Require R console, whole-run reset, deterministic tape replay on both executors. File measured upstream blockers without narrowing scope. Gate implementation completion is distinct from rung acceptance.
notes: Gate implementation and recorded LLVM 18/23 run complete, full acceptance remains blocked. RESULTS.md and .tmp/rung-3/20261101T125405.461872Z/ carry the table and exact evidence. Ordered upstream prerequisites: brt-1ft, brt-cgb, bp-ivy, bennett-driver-cyg, b-isa-spec-221, b-isa-spec-04d, bennett-vm-u8m. Ordinary musl hello.c fails on missing stdio.h; all required downstream stages are BLOCKED. Published device/reset controls pass on both executors but do not establish hello-world or tape-consuming replay. Eight gate tests, rung-2 five tests/AST identity, checker 2, clauses 113, suite 23 and neutral 16/16 pass. No sibling source changes, no push, no Dolt sync.
